title: Üsküdar'a Gider İken (Kâtibim)
attribution: Anonymous Istanbul folk song (türkü) from the time of the Crimean War; the tune was already in print in the 1850s (Anton Pann's Romanian collection) and the composer and poet are unknown, so melody and words are public domain. First verse and refrain. The raised 7th (C#) is expected to show as out-of-key; the long rests are where the saz answers the singer.
